digest.component_or_area: live Jira Cloud S3-backed integration test suite
propositions: A new read-only live test suite under tests/external/live_jira_cloud_s3/ validates Jira Cloud S3-backed reconciliation against real projects REB and DIG at production volume.
The suite uses compute_snapshot (inbound fetch) and bridge_preview (DRY_RUN mode) without mutations; structural read-only enforcement monkeypatches all AcliClient mutating methods to raise.
An autouse fixture provides an isolated S3-backed store with throwaway prefix remote, ensuring no production reach; prefix is deleted post-run.
Per-project fetch scoping is validated: REB+DIG mapping fetches both projects; single-project mapping fetches only that project; unknown projects fail-closed.
Unknown mapped project keys cause compute_snapshot to raise rather than silently succeed, and per-project Jira issue counts remain identical before/after all scenarios.
